symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: For every entity with eoc::camp::AvatarContainerComponent on which ls::savegame::LoadedEventOneFrameComponent was just added (a savegame finished loading), the query carries esv::camp::AvatarContainerRequestsComponent and esv::camp::AvatarContainerTriggerComponent as optional slots: an empty Requests slot gets AvatarContainerRequestsComponent added, an empty Trigger slot gets AvatarContainerTriggerComponent added. It returns whether it added anything - this upgrades containers from saves that lack the two components.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9FA0C0 lines 136-206 read: DAT_182231200 = Added-query (AvatarContainerComponent + LoadedEventOneFrame, optional Requests/Trigger); slot-null tests at lines 149 and 178; add helpers +0x9F4B60 (DAT_1821f4960 = AvatarContainerRequestsComponent) and +0x9F4DD0 (DAT_182231244 = AvatarContainerTriggerComponent). Same in bg3_dx11.exe: +0x2BEE880 (query spec type name at +0x3E08A0), add helpers +0x2BF06A0 and +0x2BF0590, caller +0x2BEED20 called by +0x238E490. Review 2026-11-14 (Opus, systems I): the two slot tests are "slot pointer is null" before each add, slot 0 -> +0x9F4B60 (Requests), slot 1 -> +0x9F4DD0 (Trigger); re-read.
does.check: not checkable live: needs a save loaded with a container missing a component (an old save); a recipe starts from the copy's checkpoint

does.text: If nothing was upgraded and an existing container is not returned by +0x9F9040, and no entity holds eoc::gamestate::SavegameLoadComponent, it counts the entities with eoc::user::AvatarComponent; with more than one avatar it takes the last AvatarContainerTemplate (asserting when there is none), creates the container item from it, and adds eoc::camp::AvatarContainerComponent, esv::camp::AvatarContainerRequestsComponent and esv::camp::AvatarContainerTriggerComponent to it. Review 2026-11-14 (Opus, systems I): when +0x9F9040 finds a container it is returned and nothing is created; the creation path is entered only when nothing was upgraded and none was found. The run branch's earlier text (bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BEED20 lines 77-271, guards not worked out) is this branch.
